title: PxDocument
description: A complete .px document — the root AST node.

Accessor.description: Access path segment on a variable or expression.

ConfigDecl.description:
```px
config defaults:
  max_retries: 3
  timeout: 5000
  nested:
    key: "value"
```

ConstraintDecl.description:
```px
constraint no_empty_responses:
  scope: response
  phase: pre_send
  require: response.length > 0
  severity: error
  message: "Empty responses are never acceptable"
```

ContractDecl.description:
```px
contract tone_matching:
  given: "User sends casual message"
  when: "Responding to user"
  then: "Match casual tone"
  threshold: 0.8
  examples:
    - input: "hey what's up"
      expect: "casual_tone"
```

DataflowParam.description:
A typed parameter with optional queue binding.
`name: Type from "queue_name"`

source_queue.description: The queue this parameter reads from.

DataflowProcedureDecl.description:
```px
procedure classify_and_route(msg: InboundMessage from "inbound") -> RouteDecision into "route_decision":
  given: "Classify message intent and determine routing"
  classify_intent msg.content -> $intent
  route_by_intent $intent -> $destination
  return {intent: $intent, destination: $destination}
```

DataflowReturn.description:
Return type with optional queue binding.
`-> Type into "queue_name"`

dest_queue.description: The queue output is pushed to.

EntityDecl.description:
```px
entity Player:
  prefix: "player"
  fields:
    health: int
    name: string
    inventory: list[string]
```

FactDecl.description:
```px
fact MemoryEntry:
  content: string
  category: string
  timestamp: int
```

FieldDecl.description: A typed field declaration used in entities, facts, and function params.

FunctionDecl.description:
```px
function classify_intent(message: string) -> string:
  mode: deterministic
  """Classify the user's intent from message content."""
```

Ident.description:
An identifier (variable name, construct name, field name).
Invariant: ASCII_ALPHA | "_" followed by ASCII_ALPHANUMERIC | "_"

LegacyProcedureDecl.description:
```px
procedure handle_message:
  trigger: on_write("inbound")
  params: [$message]
  given: "Process an incoming message"
  steps:
    classify_intent $message -> $intent
    ...
```

oneOf.description: v2: Rust-style code block with braces

ProcedureTrigger.description: Legacy trigger (deprecated — prefer dataflow queue bindings).

RuleDecl.description:
```px
rule detect_urgency:
  priority: 10
  when:
    - message.contains("urgent")
  then:
    - action: flag_priority level: "high"
```

ScenarioDecl.description:
```px
scenario test_routing:
  given: "User sends a question"
  setup:
    define $msg = "What time is it?"
  run: classify_intent {input: $msg}
  expect:
    - result_contains {text: "question"}
```

Statement.description:
A top-level statement in a .px file.

Adjacently tagged (`{ "kind": "Entity", "value": { .. } }`) so the JSON
projection is stable and legible for TS/schema consumers and handles every
variant shape uniformly (PXLANG-M2 §3.1.2).

StringLiteral.description:
A string literal (single or double quoted in source).
The value is the content WITHOUT surrounding quotes.

TriggerDecl.description:
```px
trigger daily_consolidation:
  on: timer
  schedule: "0 3 * * *"
  run: consolidate_memories
```

TypeAliasDecl.description:
`type <Name> = <TypeExpr>` - the 13th surface construct.
RFC-0002 specifies that its later semantic-core lowering targets `Declaration`; this
AST preserves the surface construct and its type expression for that lowering.

TypeExpr.description: A type expression used in field declarations, params, and return types.

oneOf.description: User-defined type name (refers to an entity or fact)

RFC-0002: a base/collection type narrowed by a boolean predicate over `value`.
Scope per RFC-0002 §1: only `Base`, `List`, `Optional`, `Map`, `Enum` may be the
refined base (no `Named`, no nested `Refined`). The predicate is an ordinary v1
`Expr` with exactly one free variable bound by convention to `value`.

Value.description: A value that can appear in declarations, step arguments, or config entries.

oneOf.description: Arithmetic expression: `a + b` (simple binary in value position)
Bare identifier used as value (e.g., enum variant name)
